decisions.reason: Chinese 騫味道 is Qian Weidao (騫 Qiān + 味道 Wèidào); Wei Chawei misreads the surname and given name. The proposed idiomatic corrects only that personal name.
The literal likewise has Wei Chawei for 騫味道; Qian Weidao is the correct reading, and the rest of the proposed literal matches the Chinese.
Chinese 吳少誠 is Wu Shaocheng (誠 Chéng), not Wu Shaochuan; the proposed idiomatic restores the correct given name and leaves the accusation wording intact.
The literal also misreads 吳少誠 as Wu Shaochuan; Wu Shaocheng matches 誠, and the proposed replacement corrects only that name.

claimRetractions.reason: Wei Chawei exists only as the bad English spelling of 騫味道; accepting r0001 restores Qian Weidao (already claimed in c0025) and leaves no source support for this personal-name.
Wu Shaochuan exists only as the bad English spelling of 吳少誠; accepting r0003 restores Wu Shaocheng (already claimed in c0154) and leaves no source support for this personal-name.

claimRevisions.reason: Accepted r0001 shows 騫味道 is explicitly Qian Weidao in s0010; with Wei Chawei retracted, c0025 must be explicit rather than strongly-inferred while keeping id, subject, predicate, value, and evidence.
